subject.title: [Bug]: Regression of #65533 — reasoning/reasoning_details completely dropped from message history for MiniMax M3 via OpenRouter (both plain-text and tool-call turns)

question: Should maintainers refresh/review the linked PR and accept its route-accurate loopback proof as sufficient for this MiniMax M3 replay regression, or require live OpenRouter proof first?
rationale: The issue is source-reproducible and has an open candidate fix, but final closure depends on maintainer acceptance of the proof scope and a conflict-free PR.

options.title: Refresh And Review Linked PR
options.body: Resolve the conflict on the linked PR, review the focused sanitizer/transcript-policy fix, and accept route-accurate payload proof if it still covers both turn shapes.

options.title: Require Live OpenRouter Proof
options.body: Keep the issue open and require a redacted live OpenRouter/MiniMax M3 next-request payload capture before merge.

options.title: Close Candidate And Keep Issue Open
options.body: If the linked branch is no longer worth salvaging, close that PR and keep this issue as the canonical report for a new focused fix.

recommendation.title: Refresh And Review Linked PR
recommendation.body: Resolve the conflict on the linked PR, review the focused sanitizer/transcript-policy fix, and accept route-accurate payload proof if it still covers both turn shapes.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has recent OpenRouter reasoning replay history and already provided maintainer review direction on the linked PR.
